key_points: Deutsche Bank upgraded NFLX to Buy citing international growth and AI upside, providing a near-term positive catalyst
Stock down ~26% YTD and ~14% this month, reflecting broad growth concerns and post-earnings weakness
Multiple negative headlines highlight investor anxiety over subscriber growth, competition, and billionaire selling
Upgrade is a single analyst move; not a fundamental shift in thesis or guidance
Mixed signals suggest range-bound trading ahead of next earnings or clearer growth evidence
